title: Grateful Dead Live at The Ark on 1969-04-21
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> CD D

ai_review.summary: Classic 1969 soundboard recording with a high‑energy show highlighted by a soaring Dark Star, fiery Foxy Lady jam and an epic The Other One.
ai_review.review: The tape captures the raw, “classic ’69” sound that fans love – clear enough for a soundboard from this era and praised as well recorded throughout. Musically the concert bursts with energy after a loose first set, delivering standout moments like Dark Star, The Eleven, a jam‑filled Foxy Lady segue, an intense The Other One and a gorgeous Viola Lee encore. Minor slip‑ups in the early songs are outweighed by the overall fire of the second set.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4–5) and enthusiastic comments about both performance and recording quality; show praised as energetic with many standout songs, while the recording is described as well‑captured for its era.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as classic 1969 sound, amazingly well recorded for the period; clear enough to hear details like slide guitar, no major drop‑outs or muddiness mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set starts a bit sloppy but quickly gains momentum; second set flows brilliantly with seamless jams and high‑energy transitions, ending with an expansive encore.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Slide guitar on Hard To Handle noted (awesome by some, just interesting by others); Jerry drives the Foxy Lady jam and delivers strong leads throughout.
